text: The 2025 loss area is classified as native forest by the **MGAP forest map (2021)**, which identifies 13.1 ha of the affected area as native forest, with only 0.4 ha outside mapped forest and no planted forest detected. This classification aligns with the territorial context of the asset, which is also labeled as native forest. The JRC GFC2020 data further supports this, showing a 98% agreement that the area was forested in 2020. However, the cause of the loss (e.g., harvesting, fire, or natural disturbance) remains unspecified.
